candidateAudit.title: Thanks for joining the opening of the exhibition ‘03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ this week! At AIL researchers and artists show the
candidateAudit.text: Thanks for joining the opening of the exhibition ‘03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ this week! At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphor. — on till 5 Nov 2026 Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 The exhibition emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). With contributions by: Franziska Allerberger (Geographer), Michael Bahn (Ecologist), Helena Detsch (Visual Artist), Cornelia Dirnberger (Visual Artist), Christian Prohammer (Musician, Audio Engineer), Nora Schöpfer (Visual Artist), Konstantina Maria Serjannis (Cultural Scientist), Johanna Unterpertinger (Musician) Next guided tours: 15 Oct, 16:00–18:00 Guided Tour and Soil Session with Christian Prohammer 21 Oct, 16:00—18:00 Guided Tour and Soil Session with Christian Prohammer 5 Nov 12:00—13:00 Guided Tour 13:15—15:30 Workshop with Franziska Allerberger Out of Balance: On the Quest for Reconnecting (Register via this link) Photos: Hannah Mayr _hannahmayr_ The project 03: Soil is generously supported by ÖAW. oeaw.at

candidateAudit.title: Artificial intelligence is often framed as a quest to replicate the human brain, promising frictionless cognition and a future of seamless automation. But what if this pervasive na
candidateAudit.text: Artificial intelligence is often framed as a quest to replicate the human brain, promising frictionless cognition and a future of seamless automation. But what if this pervasive narrative obscures a deeper, more ‘errant’ truth? Media theorist and author Clemens Apprich in conversation with philosopher Jan Völker. Moderated by Amanda Holmes, Department of Philosophy, University of Applied Arts Vienna Welcome: Ulrike Kuch, Rector of the University of Applied Arts Vienna A cooperation of the department of Media Theory and the department of Philosophy. ‘Errant Intelligence’ challenges the prevailing biological and individualistic interpretations of machine learning, arguing instead for a radical understanding of machine intelligence. The book embraces the deviations, inconsistencies, and ‘errant behaviour’ as fundamental to the discovery of new knowledge, moving beyond the illusion of mere optimisation. Drawing on media theory, cybernetics, and a unique psychoanalytic lens, it explores the ‘technological unconscious’ of machine learning. It traces the historical roots of AI, from early automatons and the Turing machine to natural language processing and contemporary machine learning systems. Challenging the idea of an autonomous, self-generating AI, the book exposes the hidden labour, assumed logics, and inherent biases that animate its operation. It re-evaluates computational thinking, insisting on its inherently social, collective, and symbolic character, and revealing how language and logical paradoxes are not obstacles but constitutive forces that shape intelligent machines

candidateAudit.title: In this workshop with Helena Detsch we will explore simple ways to create a fascinating natural color palette from soil and plant-based materials like earths, minerals, vegetables,
candidateAudit.text: In this workshop with Helena Detsch we will explore simple ways to create a fascinating natural color palette from soil and plant-based materials like earths, minerals, vegetables, kitchen supplies and algae pigments. Part of the exhibition ‘03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ Duration: 15:30–17:30 Please register for this workshop via link in bio (free entry) Together, we'll first experiment with making self-made oil- or watercolors from 100% natural sources and then explore the many possibilities of sustainable painting, discovering how these self-made colors behave on paper and fabric and what a truly organic painting practice can look like. In her oil paintings, installations and animations, Helena Detsch explores (mis-)relationships between humans and more-than-human life. Her series and immersive spatial installations question Western anthropocentric narratives about nature as a resource and create spaces to reflect on coexistence and complex interconnections between human and other agents. To develop a more sustainable art practice, she crafts natural colors from plant and soil pigments. helena.kettu AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna dieangewandte

candidateAudit.text: About the next exhibition at AIL: Soil is a highly diverse and sensitive cosmos that is facing increasing pressure due to the climate crisis, as a result of more frequent and severe extreme events such as drought. Soil holds histories, stories and belowground storage systems, repositories of information and traces of past worlds, current developments and future scenarios. What is happening beneath our feet? At AIL researchers and artists show their open, collaborative process, which unfolds in a multiperspective inquiry on soil and drought. This creates a dialogue at the intersection of data collection, scientific exploration and artistic translation, in which soil becomes a ground for research, creativity, evidence and metaphors. With contributions by: Franziska Allerberger (Geographer), Michael Bahn (Ecologist), Helena Detsch (Visual Artist), Cornelia Dirnberger (Visual Artist), Christian Prohammer (Musician, Audio Engineer), Nora Schöpfer (Visual Artist), Konstantina Maria Serjannis (Cultural Scientist), Johanna Unterpertinger (Musician) ’03: Soil. Between (De-)Composition and (Re-)Construction in the Climate Crisis’ emerges from the project 03: Soil, which is based on interdisciplinary and site-specific artistic research, and is rooted in a collective field exploration of a subalpine ecological research laboratory in the Stubai Valley (Tyrol, Austria). Join the extended exhibition program: 6 Oct Exhibition Opening with Performances by Michael Bahn, Johanna Unterpertinger and Christian Prohammer 8 Oct 15:30–17:30 Workshop with Helena Detsch The Organic Painter – Painting

candidateAudit.text: Fit für Demokratie 💪 Der FSW hat im Rahmen von Inklusives Wien 2030 eine Veranstaltung zum Internationalen Tag der Demokratie organisiert. Das Thema war: Fit für Demokratie. Eine Gruppe von Menschen mit Behinderungen hat die Veranstaltung vorbereitet. In mehreren Treffen haben sie den Inhalt und den Ablauf gestaltet. 💬Es gab einen Vortrag über Demokratie: 👉 Dabei ging es um Demokratie in Österreich. 👉 Es wurde erklärt, wie Demokratie entstanden ist und wie man mitbestimmen kann. 👉 Es ging auch um die Aufgaben von Bund, Bundesländern und Gemeinden. Danach gab es zwei Demokratie-Fitness-Trainings. 🤝 Die Teilnehmer:innen haben geübt, wie man sich mit anderen Menschen verbindet und die Gemeinschaft stärkt. 👂Sie haben auch geübt, wie man aufmerksam zuhört. Über 50 Personen waren dabei. Es gab viele Gespräche und Diskussionen. Danke an alle, die dabei waren und mitgeholfen haben! 🧡 #FSW #InklusivesWien2030 #DemokratieTag #Inklusion #StadtWien

candidateAudit.text: Demenz verändert den Alltag – für Menschen mit Demenz ebenso wie für ihre Angehörigen. candidateAudit.title: Coming up next as part of VIENNA DESIGN WEEK 2026 🪢 The exhibition ’Zero and One Chairs’ was created as part of MATCH!, a recurring initiative organised by the department of Appli
candidateAudit.text: Coming up next as part of VIENNA DESIGN WEEK 2026 🪢 The exhibition ’Zero and One Chairs’ was created as part of MATCH!, a recurring initiative organised by the department of Applied Photography and Time-Based Media at the University of Applied Arts Vienna, which explores the synergistic potential of student teams from different degree programs. In collaboration with the department Industrial Design, this year’s focus was on the intersection of photography and the object, with particular attention paid to the relationship with set design, styling, casting and narrative. Seen from the perspective of Applied Photography, the object and thus the chair, is a welcome protagonist. Photography’s multiple applied genres are cited here: documentary, fashion, advertising, architecture and the portrait. When the function in Industrial Design coalesces with the idea of the purpose in Applied Photography, the question of factuality emerges. Be not mistaken: The most literal things are often the most confusing and enigmatic. Between what it is and how it is*, worlds unfold. We put the images to work. VDW Cocktail: 29 Sep, 17:00–18:00 Showcase and drinks followed by a collective walk to the billboards in front of the main entrance of the University Open Saturdays: 26 Sep / 3 Oct, 11:00–18:00 Opening hours: Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 AIL, Otto Wagner-Postsparkasse / Georg-Coch-Platz 2, 1010 Vienna The collaborative works are on display at the AIL and on the billboards at the university’s main entrance on Oskar-Kokoschka-Platz. dieangewandte viennadesignweek applied.photography angewandte_id Feat

candidateAudit.text: 12.090 Menschen mit Schuldenproblematik konnten 2025 Unterstützungsangebote des FSW in Anspruch nehmen. Einer davon ist Alfred. 🧡 Die FSW Schuldenberatung berät und unterstützt Menschen kostenlos und vertraulich bei Schuldenproblemen. Präventive Angebote wie der FSW-Finanzführerschein vermitteln jungen Menschen früh einen verantwortungsvollen Umgang mit Geld und helfen, Schulden zu vermeiden. Ein weiteres Angebot ist das FSW Betreute Konto. Es unterstützt Menschen in Wien dabei, ihre Wohnung trotz finanzieller Schwierigkeiten zu behalten. Die Fixkosten werden automatisch bezahlt, das restliche Geld wird auf ein Auszahlungskonto überwiesen und kann frei verwendet werden. 🤝 Unser Ziel: Menschen bei finanziellen Schwierigkeiten zu unterstützen und mit präventiven Angeboten frühzeitig vorzubeugen. 👉 Mehr Zahlen und Fakten: geschaeftsbericht.fsw.at/2025/ #FSW #Schuldenberatung #Finanzbildung #Finanzen #FSWBetreutesKonto

candidateAudit.text: Nationaler Aktionstag für pflegende Angehörige 🧡 Der nationale Aktionstag am 13. September lenkt die Aufmerksamkeit auf die wichtige Rolle pflegender Angehöriger. Viele Menschen übernehmen die Pflege und Betreuung eines nahestehenden Menschen zuhause und leisten damit einen wesentlichen Beitrag zur häuslichen Betreuung. Damit pflegende An- und Zugehörige bei dieser Aufgabe nicht alleine sind, gibt es das Netzwerk für pflegende An- und Zugehörige der FSW Pflege- und Betreuungsdienste. Es bietet Beratung, Orientierung, praktisches Wissen sowie Angebote zur Entlastung und Stärkung. 🤝 🗨️ Anlässlich des Aktionstags haben wir mit Kund:innen des Netzwerks gesprochen. Sie erzählen, welche Angebote sie nutzen und wie diese ihnen und ihren Angehörigen im Alltag helfen. 👉 Mehr Infos: pflegende-angehoerige.wien #FSW #PflegendeAngehörige #Pflege #Betreuung

candidateAudit.title: 💘 Friends? Dates? Flirting? Something in between? Meet queer people in Vienna without swiping. 📅 Sat, 26 September 2026 ⏰ 19:00–21:00 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 106
candidateAudit.text: 💘 Friends? Dates? Flirting? Something in between? Meet queer people in Vienna without swiping. 📅 Sat, 26 September 2026 ⏰ 19:00–21:00 📍 Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna 🎟️ €20 per person · cash at the door 💛 Soli tickets available 📝 Registration required 🌈 Who is it for? Queer people who want to meet other queer people — whether you’re looking for dating, friendship, flirting, new connections, or simply meeting more of the community. You’ll meet multiple people through a series of short mini-dates. Privately note who you’d like to connect with again — romantically, platonically, or otherwise. If you both choose each other, it’s a match. 💌 Contact information is only shared with mutual matches. 🧍 Coming alone? Absolutely. You don’t need to know anyone beforehand. The structured format is there to make meeting people easier, including if you’re shy, introverted, or not into approaching strangers at a bar. 💛 Can’t comfortably afford €20? Soli tickets are available. Request one in the comments when registering — no explanation or justification needed. 🤝 Consent, boundaries and mutual respect are essential. A conversation or flirtation never creates an obligation to share contact details or meet again. Discriminatory or harassing behaviour is not welcome. ♿ Step-free access · accessible seating & toilet · service animals welcome. Please note that simultaneous conversations can mean significant background noise. 📝 Register via the link in bio/event page. Come as you are and see who you click with. 💘

candidateAudit.title: What might consciousness smell like? Is it possible to sense interdependencies? Would you like to experience your embeddedness in the world? The SΫS SPACE prototype by artists duo
candidateAudit.text: What might consciousness smell like? Is it possible to sense interdependencies? Would you like to experience your embeddedness in the world? The SΫS SPACE prototype by artists duo MUELLER-DIVJAK opens its doors for two afternoons in September, inviting you for a one-of-a-kind experience, an exclusive multisensory trail of resonating with and better understanding of living systems. ⚡⚡⚡Currently all individual time slots are taken, but you can sign up for the waiting list! Find the link in our bio! Exclusive one-hour slot for a fascinating journey into your senses and search for a being that knows and feels everything about connectedness and interdependence. The artist and researcher duo MUELLER-DIVJAK (Dr. Jeanette Müller and Dr. Paul Divjak), who is working at the AIL with international artists and systems scientists on the FWF/PEEK project SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS. Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenographies for Systems Awareness (Project lead: Mag. Alexandra Graupner; University of Applied Arts), is devoted to creating experiential multisensory spaces – the so called SΫS SPACEs – that help enhancing systems awareness through special sensory cues. Such allowing for coping resiliently with the complex interrelations and interactions that shape our world and all our lives. mueller_divjak dieangewandte

candidateAudit.text: Der September zeigt sich an der Alten Donau noch einmal von seiner schönsten Seite. 🍂✨ Noch den ganzen September lang könnt ihr goldene Spätsommertage auf Wiens größtem Floß genießen – mit Blick aufs Wasser, mitten im Grünen und doch mitten in der Stadt. Und wenn der Sommer langsam weiterzieht, bleibt das, was wir am Strandcafé lieben: unsere Idylle, gutes Essen und diese besonderen Momente, in denen man einfach ein bisschen länger sitzen bleibt. Seit 1921 zuhause an der Alten Donau und heute Wiens Ripperlhochburg: Genießt unsere beliebten Ripperl vom österreichischen Schwein, unsere Aussicht und ein Stück Wien, das sich seine ganz eigene Ruhe bewahrt hat. Ein Ort mitten in der Natur. Eine Stadt, die wir seit Generationen lieben. Und ein Platz, an den man immer wieder gerne zurückkehrt. 🤍 Strandcafé Alte Donau – seit 1921.

candidateAudit.title: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developi
candidateAudit.text: Throughout August and September, the artist duo MUELLER-DIVJAK is residing at AIL for Summer Studio – using the space for artistic research, experimentation, and learning, developing the project's multisensory scenography – the so-called SΫS SPACE. Aim of the Summer Studio is to prepare the prototype of the scenography, which will be established at the AIL in June 2027 as the centerpiece of the final exhibition of the PEEK project ’SENSING LIVING SYSTEMS — Exploring the Potentials of Multisensory Scenography for Systems Awareness.’ The SΫS SPACE facilitates a physical experience of one's own embededdness within living systems, within complex interrelationships – within a greater whole. It paves the way for relational sensing and thinking – an embodied systems awareness, that can help in coping with complexity, challenges, and uncertainties, and in making good decisions towards sustainable futures. It deliberately reduces the dominance of the sense of sight, placing the emphasis instead on smell, touch, and hearing. Numerous scientists, as well as invited artists, politicians, journalists, children, senior citizens, curators, cultural workers, educators, and teenagers are individually guided through the immersive environment by Jeanette Müller and Paul Divjak and share their responses in photo-based reflections and semi-structured interviews. Their feedback directly informs the prototype. Save the date! 14 and 15 Sep 2026 The SΫS SPACE will open to the public in individual time slots for an exclusive multisensory experience. candidateAudit.text: 🎬 Sapphic Film Series: Rebel Dykes Punk meets feminism at the next edition of our Sapphic Film Series at Villa Vida Café. 🖤 Join us for a free screening of Rebel Dykes, a documentary exploring the lives of a group of lesbians who helped shape a radical queer subculture in 1980s London. Through stories of friendship, sex, activism, nightlife, art and resistance, Rebel Dykes takes us into a world where punk collided with feminism and queer people created their own spaces, communities and ways of living. Rather than presenting queer history as something distant or polished, the documentary is told through the people who were there — the rebels who lived, loved, organised, partied and challenged expectations both inside and outside feminist movements. candidateAudit.text: Every drag performance tells a story. Whether it’s joyful, political, deeply personal, or completely absurd, the most memorable performances come from artists who know how to connect with an audience. Join drag artist DaDa JV for an interactive workshop exploring the art of storytelling through drag and performance. Together, you’ll look at how movement, music, character, costume, emotion, and stage presence work together to create performances that leave a lasting impact. This workshop is open to performers of all experience levels, from those taking their first steps into drag to seasoned artists looking to deepen their creative practice. Participants are encouraged to bring ideas, works in progress, or simply their curiosity. Together we’ll explore: • Finding your unique performance voice • Building a story through movement and music • Connecting authentically with an audience • Using drag as a tool for self expression and community • Developing confidence on stage Expect a welcoming, collaborative environment where experimentation is encouraged and every participant’s perspective is valued. Event Details Saturday, August 29 4:00 PM Villa Vida Café, Linke Wienzeile 102, 1060 Vienna This workshop is donation based. Give what you can. No one will be turned away for lack of funds. Come ready to learn, share, and discover new ways to bring your story to life on stage.

candidateAudit.text: Looking for a relaxed evening of games and great company? Join Gayme Night Vienna at Villa Vida Café for a free community board game night where everyone is welcome. Whether you’re an experienced strategist, a casual player, or completely new to board games, Gayme Night is all about meeting people, sharing laughs, and enjoying a welcoming queer space. Bring your favourite game or choose from our growing collection of board and card games. Come with friends or come on your own—there’s always a table to join. Event Details 📅 Date: Friday, 29 August 🕕 Time: 18:00–21:00 📍 Location: Villa Vida Café, Vienna 💸 Entry: Free No registration is required. Simply drop by whenever you’d like during the evening. What to Expect at Gayme Night At Gayme Night Vienna, you’ll find: * A relaxed and welcoming atmosphere * Classic and modern board games * Card games and party games * Opportunities to meet new people * Delicious drinks and food available throughout the evening * A community space where everyone is welcome Whether you enjoy cooperative adventures, competitive strategy games, quick party games, or social deduction, there’s something for every play style. Who Can Join? Gayme Night Vienna is open to everyone. Villa Vida Café is a queer community café that welcomes people of all genders, sexual orientations, identities, backgrounds, and experience levels. Whether it’s your first visit or you’re already part of the community, you’ll find a friendly and inclusive space. Come solo, bring a partner, invite friends, or meet new people during the evening. candidateAudit.text: Over the past season, every spin, every step, and every dance has made a real difference. 💜 Thanks to your generosity, Queer Salsa Wien has raised over €850 for the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund (QVMAF) this year already. The Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund provides one-off emergency microgrants to queer people in Vienna experiencing unexpected financial hardship. Whether someone is struggling to pay rent, buy groceries, cover medical costs, or get through another crisis, these grants help community members when they need it most. A huge thank you to the incredible Queer Salsa Wien team for organising these classes, and to everyone who has danced, donated, volunteered, and supported this initiative. Every donation, no matter the size, helps build a stronger community based on solidarity and mutual care. Queer Salsa classes will be back at Villa Vida in October but in the meantime you can join their outdoor classes and parties. Follow queersalsawien for information. The Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund is an initiative started by hint.wien and villavidacafe. If you’d like to learn more about the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund or make a donation, visit queervienna.at. See you on the dance floor soon. 💃🏽🕺🏿❤️ 💜 Thank you, queersalsawien ! Over €850 raised for the Queer Vienna Mutual Aid Fund in 2026—thank you to everyone who danced and donated. QVMAF provides emergency microgrants to queer people in Vienna facing unexpected financial hardship. Learn more or support the fund at queervienna.at

candidateAudit.text: The exhibition [REVERBERATED]. Following the Movement of Memory is still running till this Friday, July 10! Mon–Fri: 11:00–18:00 Last guided tour: Thur, July 9, 17:00 Memory is not a stable record of the past. Rather than functioning as a static archive, it unfolds as a dynamic process in which traces are continuously reshaped by perception, narration, and material conditions. Across these artistic approaches, [REVERBERATED] invites visitors to consider memory not as something simply preserved, but as something continuously produced through interactions between bodies, technologies, and environments. The exhibition thus explores how the past continues to reverberate within the systems of the present. With contributions by: Agustina Belén Agüero, Lobna Awidat, Phin Anibal, Rimon Alyagon Darr, Ronnie Danaher, Tatiana Del Valle, Hasti Ghasedi, Leah Barbara Mukui Giertz, Hanna Hofmann, Tal Horesh, Mauritius Itzinger, Laura Isselhorst, Dina Karaman, Moritz Klarer, Anna Buchner, Leonard Otterbein, David Ristić, Rajarshi Sarkar, Agnes Schyberg, Aryan Shahabian, Majedeh Shahvelayati, Mehrta Shirzadian, Pauline Simon, Laura Chalabi, People of Soil Photos: Lea Dörl

candidateAudit.title: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafi
candidateAudit.text: A new series of postcards is now installed at Café Exchange cafe_exchange The series was extracted from the course ‘Drawing: Here & Now’ by Simon Goritschnig zeichnungunddruckgrafik In collaborative drawing, two people share a single pen – the line becomes a space of negotiation. A play between control and letting go. Who leads – and when? Impulse meets resistance, conviction meets empathy. Not always a conversation, but always an understanding – a dance on paper. These and other experiments are part of the course “Drawing: Here & Now” by Simon Goritschnig, in which students of the department Drawing and Printmaking explore various qualities of drawing beyond observational study. In the project “Reflex,” these experimental setups are set against observational drawing. Students draw in the cashier hall of the former Postsparkasse, intuitively picking up details from architecture and space, as well as situations of coming together: conversations, movements, gazes. In this process, it becomes visible how public and social space is visually probed and explored. The focus lies on reflection — with, through, and within drawing. With contributions by: Andrea Vairelles, Anna Marino, Beth Sorby, Emilia Schönwiese, Flora Schmid, Hannah Horn, Henriette Sonntag, Leo Hasslinger, Maria Lutkova, Max Offergeld, Nikolaus Kohout, Sophie Schweizer, Anija S Dartizio, Timo Pfeifer, Vera Kügel AIL in cooperation with the department Drawing and Printmaking and Simon Goritschnig Image: Henriette Sonntag Design: Atelier Dreibholz Concept Postcard Editions and Production: Eva Weber

candidateAudit.title: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:00 The Geography of Yellow Walls Performance by Mehrta Shirzadian mehrrta Bright yellow becomes
candidateAudit.text: For Angewandte Festival, we planned five more exhibition activations: 4 Jul 2026, 15:00 The Geography of Yellow Walls Performance by Mehrta Shirzadian mehrrta Bright yellow becomes a quiet declaration of care, resistance, and return. Here, the body is reclaimed as homeland, shaped by experience rather than imposed borders. A performance unfolding through turmeric as healing material and the body as living territory. The work is rooted in a deep commitment to women’s health and critical scientific perspectives, engaging forms of embodied knowledge that have long been ignored or erased. The body becomes both evidence and memory, offering its own geography as a space of protection, defiance, and belonging. The performance is adapted to each site, responding to the spatial and contextual conditions of different venues. Mehrta Shirzadian is a performance and multimedia artist and artistic ­researcher working at the intersection of art and science. With a background in molecular biology, mathematics, and computer science, she creates participatory works exploring microbial life, sound, and bodily ecologies, addressing embodiment, agency, and the politics of representation. Part of the exhibition [REVERBERATED]. candidateAudit.title: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alt
candidateAudit.text: On view till Saturday (18:00) – An installation presented by the department of Digital Arts / Part of Angewandte Festival René’s Collapse Collection’ is a fictional startup and alternative investment platform that explores the cultural, economic, and emotional afterlife of the collapse of René Benko’s SIGNA empire. Through NFTs, merchandise, video works, and performative sales strategies, the project examines how value is produced through speculation, narrative, and collective belief. Originally developed through public interventions, the project was expanded through a student take over by Digitale Kunst. This exhibition presents new project strands developed by the students: an NFT series reflecting on financial dependency, a merchandise collection appropriating the aesthetics of startup culture and luxury branding, and a series of short-form videos combining influencer culture, promotional performance, and social commentary. Operating at the intersection of installation, performance, and participatory fiction, Renés Collapse Collection invites visitors to engage directly with the mechanisms of speculation, value production, and collapse. A project by by Zora Hünermann and Jakob Margit With contributions by: Ulrike Fritzsche, Koschka Cosmo Keye, Juarez Suarez, Ghanishka Kedar, Sei Jeung, Ghazal Naeimi, Dongjoo Kim, Jazzmin, Margherita Pruneti, Nicolás Henao Bonnet, Roma Bogdanov, and Grisha Terno.

candidateAudit.text: 29 Jahre jung - wie jedes Jahr. 🥂 Christina Lugner hat auch heuer wieder ihren „29. Geburtstag“ gefeiert - und wo sonst, wenn nicht auf dem schönsten Floß Wiens? 🚤✨ Bei bestem Wetter, guter Laune, leckeren Ripperln und vielen bekannten Gesichtern wurde gelacht, geplaudert und natürlich angestoßen. candidateAudit.text: ✨ Happy Birthday, Mausi! ✨ Wenn sich an der Alten Donau wieder zahlreiche bekannte Gesichter versammeln, dann ist eines sicher: Christina Lugner feiert Geburtstag. 🎂 Auch heuer durften wir Teil dieses besonderen Tages sein und gemeinsam mit Christina, ihren Gästen und dem einzigartigen Blick über die Wiener Skyline einen unvergesslichen Abend erleben. Und was bei einer Feier an der Alten Donau natürlich nicht fehlen darf? Unsere beliebten Ripperl. 🍖 Hier ein kleiner Rückblick auf einen Nachmittag voller guter Gespräche, herzlicher Begegnungen und vieler glücklicher Momente am Wasser. 🌊 Liebe Christina, danke für dein Vertrauen und dafür, dass wir auch dieses Jahr wieder Teil deiner Geburtstagsfeier sein durften. 🤍🌸 Wir freuen uns schon auf das nächste Jahr – wenn du wieder 29 wirst. ✨🥳 #HappyBirthday #ChristinaLugner #AlteDonau #Wien #Skyline

candidateAudit.text: 🍯 Die echte Marlenka im Strandcafé Viele kennen Marlenka – aber nur wenige kennen, wie sie wirklich schmecken soll. candidateAudit.text: 🌟Gewinnspiel🌟 Unter allen Teilnehmer verlosen wir zwölf Gewinner*innen nach Zufallsprinzip. Die Gewinne: - 6 x 25€ Verzehrgutschein - 6 x Takumi T-Shirt oder Takumi Poster Das musst du tun um am Gewinnspiel teilzunehmen: 1. Abonnieren: Folge takumi.essen.chickenvegan wenn du es noch nicht tust 2. Liebe: Schenke uns dein Herz und Like den Beitrag 3.Teile: Markiere drei deinen Lieblingmensch. Die Teilnahme am Gewinnspiel ist kostenlos. Teilnahmebedingungen: Die Dauer des Gewinnspiels erstreckt sich vom 21.12.2024 bis zum 31.12.2024 23:59 Uhr. Der Gewinner wird bis zum 01.01.2025 per DM benachrichtigt und auf Instagram (takumi.essen.chickenvegan ) bekannt gegeben. Teilnahmeberechtigt sind natürliche Personen, die Ihren Wohnsitz in Deutschland und das 16. Lebensjahr vollendet haben. Im Falle eines Gewinns, erklärt sich der Gewinner mit der Veröffentlichung seines Instagram-Namens in den vom Veranstalter genutzten Werbemedien einverstanden. Dies schließt die Bekanntgabe des Gewinners auf der Webseite des Betreibers und seinen Social Media Plattformen mit ein. Der Betreiber behält sich vor, nach eigenem Ermessen Personen von der Teilnahme auszuschließen, wenn berechtigte Gründe vorliegen, beispielsweise (a) bei Manipulationen im Zusammenhang mit Zugang zum oder Durchführung des Gewinnspiels, (b) bei VerstöBen gegen diese Teilnahmebedingungen, (c) bei unlauterem Handeln oder (d) bei falschen oder irreführenden Angaben im Zusammenhang mit der Teilnahme an dem Gewinnspiel. Die Teilnahme ist nur innerhalb des Teilnahmezeitraums möglich. Nach Teilnahmeschluss eingehende Einsendungen

candidateAudit.text: Liebe Naschkatzen, werte Schleckermäuler, Schokoholics und Lakritzfreunde! Wir haben einen betriebsamen Adventauftakt hinter uns - vielen Dank, dass ihr uns so zahlreich besucht und wir euch die Weihnachtszeit versüßen dürfen! Wir erlauben uns einen kleinen Service-Post in eigener Sache: falls ihr eure in unserem Onlineshop bestellten Glückshormone pünktlich zu Weihnachten unter dem Christbaum haben wollt, tätigt eure Bestellungen bitte bis spätestens Dienstag, den 17.12.2024. Danach stehen wir euch noch für kurzfristige Geschenkesuche und Eigenbedarfsdeckung bis zum 24.12., 14 Uhr im Geschäft zur Verfügung. Ausserdem haben wir auch kommende Woche noch zusätzlich samstags von 11-16h geöffnet. Wir wünschen euch weiterhin einen schönen Advent und freuen uns über eure Besuche und Bestellungen! Mit Eck-stra süßen Grüßen, Raphaela & Nicole

candidateAudit.title: Liebe Naschkatzen, werte Schleckermäuler, Schokoholics und Lakritzfreunde! Wie viele wahrscheinlich bereits mitbekommen haben, hat sich das liebe Ehepaar Kornherr in den wohlverdie
candidateAudit.text: Liebe Naschkatzen, werte Schleckermäuler, Schokoholics und Lakritzfreunde! Wie viele wahrscheinlich bereits mitbekommen haben, hat sich das liebe Ehepaar Kornherr in den wohlverdienten Ruhestand verabschiedet und das süße Eck vertrauensvoll in unsere Hände gelegt. Wir sind Nicole Heinrich und Raphaela Mastella und vielleicht kennen uns manche von euch als Backterium, das ist unsere 10 Jahre alte Auftragskonditorei. Einige Kunden durften wir in den letzten Wochen bereits persönlich kennenlernen und dabei schon einiges über eure Lieblingsprodukte lernen, die wir natürlich weiterhin im Sortiment haben werden. Schließlich soll niemand auf seine Trüffelkugeln, Lieblingslakritze, Schichtnougat oder lieb gewonnenes Blockmalz verzichten müssen. Trotzdem dürft ihr gespannt auf ein paar süsse Sortimentserweiterungen sein. Den Juli und Anfang August werden wir gut nutzen um uns in unserem neuen Zuhause einzurichten und für euch vorzukosten damit wir mit 26. August persönlich für euch da sein können. Wer sich, verständlicherweise, die Wartezeit versüßen möchte, kann sich gerne in unserem Webshop mit den nötigen Grundnaschungsmitteln versorgen. Infos zur Eröffnung erhaltet ihr natürlich rechtzeitig in einem eigenen Eck-strablatt. Bis bald, Eure süßen Eck-sperten Raphaela und Nicole

candidateAudit.title: Time to say Goodbye🍬 Es wird langsam Zeit, Abschied zu nehmen und Danke zu sagen. Danke für Eure Treue und Liebe zum süßen Eck - denn es gilt: die besten Schokoladen und Süßwaren
candidateAudit.text: Time to say Goodbye🍬 Es wird langsam Zeit, Abschied zu nehmen und Danke zu sagen. Danke für Eure Treue und Liebe zum süßen Eck - denn es gilt: die besten Schokoladen und Süßwaren wären nichts wert, wenn sie nicht von Euch wertgeschätzt werden. 💕 Wir sind bis 28.06. im Geschäft - wir würden uns freuen, wenn wir uns noch einmal sehen und verabschieden können (in der letzten Woche wird es auch viele Aktionen geben😉). Wer das nicht schafft, kann auch gerne auf unserer Website vorbeischauen. Ab jetzt gibt es dort nämlich zwei Farewell-Pakete zu bestellen!🍭 Es waren tolle Zeiten, gemeinsam Neuheiten zu entdecken und Altbewährtes zu genießen. Danke. Liebe Grüße, Gabriele und Michael Kornherr Die Alten vom süßen Eck🍫
